images.alt: The empty Coach Barn is arranged with a hollow-square conference table, flags, microphones, and place cards.
Three delegates approach through a brick arch, with the Shelburne Farms landscape beyond them.
A smiling delegate in a gray blazer walks across the Shelburne Farms courtyard.
Black-and-white portrait of a suited delegate looking down during an outdoor arrival.
Four delegates walk out of the Coach Barn beneath its tall brick arch.
A conference staff member crosses the courtyard carrying a blue folder and yellow lanyard.
A delegate wearing glasses speaks with another attendee during the morning arrival.
A smiling speaker addresses the room at a microphone in a black-and-white photograph.
Delegates around the conference table smile as they listen to an opening speaker.
A row of delegates listens from behind microphones and nameplates inside the Coach Barn.
A speaker is framed between blurred attendees in a black-and-white view across the table.
Delegates sit in profile along the table while one participant watches the speaker.
A bearded delegate wearing glasses speaks into a microphone during the working session.
Two delegates listen closely, one resting his chin beside a woman at a microphone.
Black-and-white side view of delegates seated shoulder to shoulder behind tabletop microphones.
A delegate listens across the table with a Canadian flag filling the foreground.
A delegate speaks across the hollow-square table as microphones and water glasses frame the foreground.
A gray-haired delegate leans forward to address the room from across the conference table.
A delegate wearing glasses listens beside a colleague in a black-and-white photograph.
A woman speaks with a tall suited delegate during a break inside the Coach Barn.
A delegate in a blue suit speaks with a colleague across the conference table.
Four delegates smile behind microphones with United States and Canadian flags behind them.
A delegate speaks at the head table beneath the projected NEG-ECP conference mark.
A summit delegate gestures while speaking beneath United States and Canadian flags inside the Coach Barn.
Two gray-haired delegates talk across the table as other participants blur into the foreground.
A seated delegate gestures while speaking at the head of the conference table.
A delegate wearing glasses listens at the table with a full audience seated behind him.
A speaker addresses the conference from a wooden lectern framed by two seated attendees.
A delegate wearing black glasses listens as another participant speaks across the table.
A delegate gestures during a small roundtable conversation near the end of the conference.
Two delegates stand together for a portrait inside the wood-paneled Coach Barn.
A delegate wearing glasses smiles while speaking with another attendee during a break.
Three women share a laugh across the table during an informal conference exchange.
Two women laugh together while another delegate smiles from her seat behind them.
Two delegates sit at the table in conversation as a colleague gestures in the foreground.
